title: Info-ZIP Zip 3.0 (and 3.1 beta through 3.1c) allows OS command injection by an attacker who controls… (CVE-2026-130335)
description: Info-ZIP Zip versions 3.0 and 3.1 beta through 3.1c contain an OS command injection vulnerability when using the -T option with a filename that includes shell metacharacters on platforms that execute a shell, such as Linux. This occurs due to the use of the system C library function. However, there is no known common scenario where an untrusted filename is passed to the zip -T command.
